title: Yang et al. 2025 — A multi-day and high-quality EEG dataset for motor imagery brain-computer interface
description: This dataset (WBCIC-SHU) contains multi-day EEG recordings from 51 healthy, right-handed participants performing motor imagery tasks for brain-computer interface (BCI) research. Participants imagined left-hand, right-hand, and (for a subset) foot movements across three sessions on different days, yielding 39,600 trials. The dataset was converted to BIDS format using MOABB and is intended to support benchmarking of motor imagery BCI classification algorithms.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W system at 1000 Hz using 59 Ag/AgCl electrodes (plus ECG and EOG channels) placed according to the standard_1005 montage, with a line frequency of 50 Hz. Participants performed synchronous offline motor imagery trials (left_hand, right_hand, and foot-hooking for a subset) cued via visual and auditory stimuli, with 1.5 s cue and 4.0 s imagery periods per trial, across three sessions per subject.
